'''S-04-12''' was a restricted security file concerning the malfunctioning of twenty [[Q-4 Borer Droid]]s that triggered a tunnel collapse in the [[Morjanssik Mine]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Reports from [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] indicated that the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] acted in a coordinated pattern, which indicated that the droids' programming had been tampered with.
